anti_claims: regrouping reuses captured routes instead of rerunning the model
regrouping can change hidden states, output tokens, and future routes
future_route_oracle and simple_greedy consume future route information
history_greedy_tminus1 is evaluated on fixed current-step routes, not an action-conditioned rerun
the pair-exchange search is deterministic but not globally optimal
no TPOT, latency, throughput, SLO-goodput, or controller headroom is claimed
single-GPU structural results are not Expert Parallel rank-pressure evidence
balance and working-set coalescing are opposite objectives and are not combined into one optimum

balance_objective_lexicographic: sum of per-layer max expert loads
sum of squared expert loads (HHI numerator)
working_set_objective_lexicographic: negative sum of squared loads (route overlap proxy)

policy_information.future_route_oracle: best simple start plus current-step pair-exchange descent
policy_information.history_greedy_tminus1: t-1 routes; original partition fallback at t=0
policy_information.simple_greedy: one-pass greedy using current-step future routes
policy_information.working_set_coalesce: current-step future-route search under the separate coalescing objective
